subject: Count dual-channel rdb-channel bytes in replication input stats

findings.detail: variant-mismatch: command 8 (EVAL_RO local s = redis.call('INFO','stats') local v = tonumber(string.match(s,'total_net_repl_input_bytes:(%d+)')) if v and v > 65536 then return 1 else return 0 end 0 on node 1) replies otherwise with server_config {"hash-max-listpack-entries":0,"list-max-listpack-size
